Dr. Meeta Bali · Parel East, Mumbai

A space for stillness, balance and healing

Meeta’s work begins with listening: to a child’s way of learning, a family’s questions, or what you need for yourself.

A special educator with a Ph.D. and a focus on autism, she began her career at B.M. Institute of Mental Health in Ahmedabad and later served as principal of Samarpan, run by SOPAN (Society of Parents of Children with Autistic Disorders). Her practice has since grown to include bodywork, breathwork, constellation work and coaching.

Across her work, she brings the same calm presence and respect for each person’s pace.

About Meeta

A research background.
A personal approach.

Meeta’s master’s project explored visual strategies for communication in children with autism. Her doctoral work examined learning, perception and behaviour through HANDLE and sensory integration interventions.

Her educational work remains at the heart of her practice. Further training has widened the ways she works with people, while her approach remains personal: take time, listen carefully and start with the individual.
